name: 0.5B Sidecar-Backed Loader Feasibility

instrumentation.approach: stderr fprintf on FFN_UP tensor load
instrumentation.issue: tensor loading path unclear or buffered

learnings: Runtime sidecar loader uses SIZE-BASED lookup - 0.5B sidecar rejected (not 7B/14B size)
PRT custom op reads from sidecar buffer g_prt_sidecar_data[il], not GGUF tensor
Graph still constructs FFN_UP tensor from GGUF - pays RAM even when PRT active
Would need loader modification to skip FFN_UP data loading
recommended_next: probe via compute-time PRT log, or modify runtime size lookup for 0.5B
